module: Node "Receive Message" (thread). Receives a message sent by another running flowgraph project (Send Message) and exposes its fields on custom output pins (pin names = message keys). Pins: flow, reset, isNetwork, name (filter), outputs flow, receiving (impulse), received. Only one message is consumed until reset.
notes: The node's description says "Sends a message..." (copy of Send Message), whereas it receives.
The name pin is only required to be non-nil: the code does not compare the message name (the "matches exactly" filter is not applied here).
The isNetwork pin is not used.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

onThreadMessageProcess.desc: Hook: stores the received message if it has not already been processed (done = false).

work.desc: On reset, resets to zero; otherwise, if a message is pending and name is given, copies its fields to the pins, activates receiving and received.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.
